title: Shut Up, Takamori!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Minamikawa is a telepath who can hear her expressionless classmate Takamori's thoughts, which are mostly earnest declarations of his love for her. The five-volume romantic comedy follows her flustered attempts to quiet his inner monologue as their feelings develop.
life_message: Sincere feelings honestly held are worth answering, even when they are embarrassing.
